quarterly_data.quarter: Merck KGaA press release: Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany to Acquire Silence (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Merck KGaA entered a definitive agreement to acquire Silence Therapeutics plc (Nasdaq: SLN), a London-headquartered clinical-stage siRNA company with approximately 80 employees in the UK, the US and Germany; closing is expected in the first quarter of 2027, subject to regulatory and Silence shareholder approvals. The deal adds Divesiran, a Phase 3-ready siRNA therapy for phlebotomy-dependent polycythemia vera dosed once every 3 months, which met its primary endpoint in the Phase 2 SANRECO study with an 88% responder rate versus 19% for placebo and reduced mean phlebotomies to 0.2 per patient versus 2.1 on placebo over weeks 0-36. The company says it gives Merck KGaA an entry point into hematology.
quarterly_data.figure: Divesiran Phase 2: 88% responder rate vs 19% placebo; 0.2 vs 2.1 phlebotomies; close expected Q1 2027
